We are looking for a highly accomplished Sr. Architect with 13+ years of experience.   • Support pre-sales, RFP responses, and client-facing solutioning activities where required.

What We're Looking For

  1. 13+ years of experience in software engineering and solutions architecture, with a demonstrable track record of leading enterprise-scale product solutioning from concept to delivery.
  2. Deep expertise in Java / Spring Boot and designing production-grade, cloud-native microservices architectures at scale.

  4. Strong architectural knowledge across frontend technologies — React.js, Angular, or equivalent — with the ability to govern frontend architecture and micro-frontend patterns.
  5. Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS and / or Azure — designing scalable, secure, and cost-optimised cloud-native solutions.
  6. Expertise in system design fundamentals — distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design, Domain-Driven Design, and CQRS / Event Sourcing.
  7. Strong experience with enterprise product solutioning — requirements analysis, technology selection, vendor assessment, and architecture roadmap development.
  8. Exceptional communication and presentation skills — proven ability to engage, influence, and align C-suite executives, senior stakeholders, and cross-functional delivery teams.
  9. Experience contributing to or leading Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) and governance processes across large technology organisations.
  10. Strong understanding of security architecture — OAuth2, Zero Trust, IAM — and regulatory compliance frameworks including GDPR.
  11. Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and instil architectural thinking and engineering excellence across delivery teams.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced, visionary, and Hands-on AI Engineering Manager to lead our AI engineering squad. In this role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production-grade software engineering. With 1217 years of experience in the technology industry, you are someone who has evolved alongside the software landscapepossessing deep roots in backend engineering and distributed systems, coupled with advanced expertise in deploying Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.As a hands-on manager, you will split your time between strategic technical leadership (coding, system architecture, prototyping) and people management (mentoring engineers, aligning with product strategy, and managing deliverables). Technical Leadership & Architecture (approx. 50%)

  • Architect AI Solutions: Design and implement robust, scalable, and secure architectures for AI-powered applications, prioritizing cost-efficiency, low latency, and reliability.

  • Evaluation & Observability: Implement comprehensive evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens) and LLM observability/monitoring systems (e.g., LangSmith, Phoenix, Arize) to ensure AI response quality and mitigate hallucinations.

  • Total Experience: 12–17 years of professional software engineering and system design experience, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade SaaS, enterprise, or consumer applications.
  • AI/ML Focus: 2-3 years of dedicated experience building and deploying machine learning or AI models, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience working directly with Generative AI, LLMs, and RAG architectures.
  • Leadership Experience: 3+ years of experience formally managing engineering teams, executing performance reviews, and steering technical roadmaps.

  • Ability to learn and adapt to changing technology landscape
  • Desire to enable change and continuous growth

  • Build AI systems that triage test failures, flaky behavior, and production escapes
  • Continuously improve testing strategies based on learnings from releases, incidents, and customer impact.

  • Skill in writing high-quality, maintainable code any one programming language

  • Experience with UI and API testing like Ginkgo and Playwright
  • Experience with Performance and Stress testing

Nice to Have

  • Experience building systems to validate AI systems including Agents

jobDescription:

- Ability and willingness to work flexible shifts when required to engage teams across global time zones.

Preferred Qualification

Preferred / Advantageous
- Experience leading technology adoption, change management, process improvement or transformation initiatives.
- Experience in a global shared-services, professional-services, insurance, financial-services or business-services organization.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate or Power Platform.
- Understanding of AI agents and workflow automation.
- Lean, Six Sigma, process-improvement or change-management experience/certification.
- Experience developing learning programs, communities of practice or champion networks.
- Understanding of responsible AI, data security and appropriate enterprise use of Generative AI.
Ideal Candidate Profile
- Passionate and genuinely curious about Generative AI and how it can transform work.
- A sophisticated hands-on user of ChatGPT, Copilot and related tools - not someone whose knowledge is primarily theoretical.
- Understands business processes and operational realities, not just technology.
- Can quickly understand someone s work and identify realistic opportunities where AI can help.
- Can turn complex AI capabilities into simple, compelling and practical examples.
- An excellent presenter, facilitator and coach who can engage both frontline employees and senior executives.
- Comfortable influencing people without direct authority.
- Commercially minded and focused on measurable outcomes.
- Self-motivated, adaptable and effective in a remote, global working environment.
- Continuously experiments, learns and stays current as AI capabilities evolve.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Adoption Practical Enablement
- Lead practical adoption of Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT and other approved Generative AI tools across global teams.
- Deliver engaging, hands-on workshops, demonstrations, learning sessions, office hours and individual coaching.
- Teach employees how to use AI effectively for their actual work rather than relying on generic AI examples.
- Develop role-based prompting techniques, reusable prompts, templates, workflows and practical guidance.
- Help employees progress from basic AI usage to integrating AI into their normal day-to-day work.
- Make Generative AI understandable and accessible to employees with different levels of technical proficiency.

2. Finance, Operations Shared Services Use Cases
Work directly with business teams to identify and implement practical AI opportunities across activities such as:
- Accounts Payable and invoice-related activities
- Accounts Receivable, collections and cash application
- Billing and invoicing
- Reconciliations and data validation
- Financial and operational reporting
- Administrative and shared-services activities
- Email drafting, summarization and communication management
- Meeting preparation, notes and follow-up actions
- Research, information synthesis and document review
- Standard operating procedures, process documentation and knowledge management
- Process analysis, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement
The individual must understand the underlying process and business objective before recommending an AI solution.

3. Use-Case Discovery Scaling
- Partner with teams to discover high-value AI opportunities and prioritize them based on practicality and business impact.
- Convert business problems into practical Copilot, ChatGPT or AI-enabled approaches that employees can use themselves.
- Build and maintain a reusable library of proven AI use cases, prompts, playbooks and examples.
- Develop function-specific AI playbooks for Finance, Operations, Shared Services and other corporate functions.
- Identify successful practices in one team or region and scale them across the global organization.
- Partner with technology or automation teams when a use case requires a more advanced solution, workflow or agent.

4. Global Engagement Facilitation
- Work with employees and leaders across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions.
- Operate flexibly across shifts and time zones to support a global workforce.
- Build credibility with both operational employees and senior business leaders.
- Adapt communication, examples and facilitation style for different cultures, functions and levels of AI maturity.
- Create and support a global network of AI champions or power users who can reinforce adoption locally.
- Communicate AI concepts in simple business language and inspire employees to experiment responsibly.

5. Change Management Continuous Improvement
- Drive behavioral change so that employees move from learning about AI to consistently using it to improve their work.
- Identify barriers to adoption and develop practical interventions to address them.
- Create communications, learning journeys and engagement activities that sustain adoption.
- Capture and communicate success stories that demonstrate tangible business value.
- Bring a continuous-improvement mindset and challenge traditional ways of working where AI can provide a better approach.

6. Measurement Business Impact
Success will be measured by business outcomes, not simply the number of training sessions delivered. The role will establish and track measures such as:
- AI adoption and active usage
- Employee proficiency and confidence
- Number of practical use cases implemented
- Hours of work or capacity saved
- Reduction in repetitive/manual activities
- Productivity, quality or cycle-time improvements
- Use cases successfully replicated across teams or regions
- Employee and stakeholder feedback
- Documented examples of measurable changes in how work is performed

[overview] Role Overview
We are seeking a senior, highly practical and passionate AI Adoption Enablement Manager to accelerate the effective use of Generative AI across our global organization. The role requires a distinctive hybrid skill set: deep practical knowledge of tools such as Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, meaningful experience in Finance Operations and/or Business Operations, strong process thinking, and the ability to engage, coach and influence employees across functions, cultures and geographies.
This is not a traditional AI engineering role and it is not simply an AI training role. The successful candidate must understand how work is actually performed and be able to translate AI capabilities into practical, relevant ways of improving day-to-day activities. The goal is measurable change in how people work - not just awareness or training attendance.
What Makes This Role Different
Knowing how to use AI tools is only one part of the requirement. We are looking for someone who can combine AI knowledge with real operational experience. For example, the individual should be able to sit with an Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Collections, Shared Services or administrative team, understand the work being performed, identify where AI can help, demonstrate a practical solution, coach employees to use it effectively, and measure the resulting improvement.
[/overview]

jobDescription:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate we re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

We are looking for a Principal AI Security Specialist to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to Ron Burkett. As enterprises race to adopt generative AI, Zscaler is seeking an experienced Principal AI Security Specialist to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI innovation and robust enterprise security. In this highly strategic, field-facing role, you will combine the elite consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and data protection to serve as a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 executives. As our premier technical authority, you will help customers confidently unlock the power of AI without compromising their data or infrastructure.

What you ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Architect the AI Technical Strategy: Partner with enterprise account teams to own and execute the technical sales strategy, driving complex, high-value AI security opportunities from discovery to close

  • Deliver Compelling, High-Impact Demos & POVs: Configure and present tailored, outcome-driven demonstrations of Zscaler s AI security platform that resonate with both deep-tech practitioners and C-level executives

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the field authority on modern AI patterns (such as RAG, agents, and prompt workflows), advising clients on how to prevent sensitive data exposure and unsanctioned AI usage

  • Scale the Field Motion: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to inject real-world customer feedback into the product roadmap, while building reusable demo assets and enablement playbooks to upscale our global sales force

  • Enable Those Around You: Develop reusable demos, technical assets, competitive positioning, and enablement content to help scale Zscaler s AI field motion while sharing best practices and training with enterprise account teams

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity, remaining comfortable building the path as you walk it and viewing dynamic environments as the raw material to create something meaningful.

  • You act like an owner, letting your passion for the mission fuel a strong bias for action while navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing a challenge culture by giving and receiving candor with clarity and respect.

  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external customers to anchor decisions in solving real-world problems.

  • You are driven by innovation, possessing a deep curiosity for how things work and an energy for solving complex technical challenges to accelerate secure transformation.

What We re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Deep Fluency in AI/GenAI: Strong foundational knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP (Model Context Protocol) orchestration patterns, and the inherent security risks associated with them

  • 10+ Years of Solutions Engineering Mastery: A proven track record in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Advisory) navigating complex, enterprise-level sales cycles

  • Enterprise Security Foundations: Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations

  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes

  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Hands-on AI Prototyping: Interacting with LLM APIs, scripting, creating agentic automation routines, and building lightweight AI applications

  • Advanced AI Risk Expertise: Direct experience helping enterprises deploy production AI technologies while navigating data leakage, model governance, compliance frameworks, and shadow AI usage

  • Scale & Enablement Focus: A history of creating high-impact field assets, technical workshops, and competitive positioning content that helps broader go-to-market teams win
